newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B index ends down 14.75 percent.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B index ends down 14.75 percent.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index plunged 14.75 percent in heavy trading on Friday because of a crackdown by local securities authorities on mainland Chinese buying B shares, brokers said.
The index plunged 25.85 points to end at 149.37 after hitting an intraday low of 146.82, on turnover of HK$432.45 million against Thursday's HK$395.77 million.
All 43 Shenzhen-listed B shares lost values.

Securities authorities have ordered brokerages in Shenzhen to stop accepting B share trading applications from domestic investors unless there was proof the money used to buy the B shares originated from outside mainland China.
Institutions dumped their holdings on Friday and sentiment is unlikely to recover over the short term after sharp falls in the index since Tuesday, brokers said.
The decline may extend to next week because the inflow of fresh money from domestic investors had been slowed by the implementation of the policy, they said.
"The index is likely to continue its drop in the coming sessions but it will not be so sharp," one analyst said.
Health Mineral Water, the biggest loser, plunged HK$1.10, or 19.61 percent, to HK$4.51 on volume of 936,648 shares.
Jiangling Motors dived HK$0.92, or 19.57 percent, to HK$3.78 on trade of 950,300 shares.
Changan Automobile fell HK$1.00 to HK$4.20 on the session's most active trade of 11.16 million shares, on heavy selling by institutions, brokers said.
Dadonghai traded the second most on volume of 5.17 million shares and ended down HK$0.86 at HK$4.00.
Motorcycle producer North Jianshe fell HK$0.91 to HK$4.05, with 4.84 million shares changing hands.

The A share index lost 23.60 points, or 4.84 percent, to 463.81 on turnover of 9.26 billion yuan compared with 14.24 billion on Thursday. The decline was due in part to heavy selling of recent, sharp gainers, brokers said.
The composite index fell 24.53 points, or 5.31 percent, to 437.13.
Poultry processor Shenzhen Kondarl fell 1.82 yuan, or 11.50 percent, to 14.00 yuan on profit-taking, brokers said.
